newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Savage to place A$53.3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Savage to place A$53.3 mln shares.

text.p: Savage Resources Ltd said on Thursday it would raise A$53.3 million through an issue of 41 million shares to institutions at a price of A$1.30 each.
Savage said the issue would be used for general corporate purposes, including development of current zinc projects and new opportunities as they arose.
It said the issue had been arranged and co-underwritten by Ord Minnett Corporate Finance Ltd and Merrill Lynch International (Australia) Ltd.
"The funds will asset Savage to grow its businesses while maintaining a conservative gearing ratio," the company said.
Savage said current projects which would significantly strengthen Savage's zinc mining and refinery businesses were:
- Resource delination and possible development of a new resource in West Kentucky and refurbishment of a concentrator
- Increasing concentrates production from the Gordonsville mining complex in Tennessee and, through substantial expansion of the underground haulage system, opening up new reserves
- Development of a small opencut at the Scotia mine, Nova Scotia, in conjuction with the dewatering-re-opening of this underground mine subject to completion of technical reviews.
"This funding will also enable Savage to increase its exploration efforts in Australia, North America and South America," the company said.

Savage said its equity commitments to the Ernest Henry copper-gold project in Queensland have been met and the balance was being sourced from a US$115 million project financing facility with Westpac Banking Corp, Deutsche Bank AG and Dresdner Australia Ltd.
It said commissioning of Ernest Henry was expected in the third quarter of 1997.
Savage has a 49 percent stake in Ernest Henry while MIM Holdings Ltd holds 51 percent.
Savage shares closed at A$1.34, down five cents.
